_what: Chimera Cozies: a spot of their own for familiars in a room (Ryan, 2026-10-19). tools/make-cozies.py draws each one, in its room's own inks, between the cozy markers on its page; familiar.js sits a familiar in a free one in the window. side is which side of the room's words the cozy stands. A new cozy is an entry here, a drawing in the tool, and a pair of markers.
